title: Delete the turn-gating code from Engram entirely: evaluate/begin/grants, control-session turn admission and their settlement/recovery paths, with their tables retired by migration import
outcome: Delete the turn-gating code from Engram entirely: evaluate/begin/grants, control-session turn admission and their settlement/recovery paths, with their tables retired by migration import
acceptance: No turn-gating code remains in Engram: the Evaluate/Begin turn grants, control-session turn admission, the settlement/rebind/recovery paths that only served them, their CLI/MCP/host operations and their tests are deleted, not disabled
The work session route (`control --work-session`), claims, host observations, registered verification and acceptance evaluation keep working, with their existing tests passing

Tables and columns that only served turn gating are dropped from the schema. `migration import` retires them by name and reports counts, keeping every other record id and link unchanged. Every live store is converted by export and import at the agreed cutover
Docs, CLI/MCP help and skills describe turn gating as removed (one history note), matching the code
The full gate passes on the exact commit, with a clean review pair, and it lands only after TermAl stops calling the removed operations (TermAl w-3fe8f4472e5d installed), at the coordinated cutover

completion.summary: Closed on Greg's word (Asistant #239): „chyba mozemy zamknac taki gated control, skoro nie mamy tego juz”. Turn gating is gone from Engram. Read today at master 2667355 and on the running hosts: removed_turn_operations_have_no_host_dispatch and removed_turn_gating_commands_and_bootstrap_flags_are_not_exposed exist; the only remaining turn_evaluate and turn_begin literals in src are that test, a doctor reader of stored history (storage/doctor.rs:590) and a test of a refused old call. readiness reports ready on the installed build, which excludes the four retired control tables by schema reference (12325's source reading, note 02b915e6); ready on Engram's store at 16:02Z, on all six at the 07:41Z landing. TermAl's non-test source uses those names only to read historical records (src/engram_session_obligations.rs). Live: since the 15:30Z restart on TermAl 24b42615, the Merger's real turns named a root, ran a check and got verification 37b75703 recorded with no grant; TermAl's holder did the same per Fable2. Limits, stated rather than papered over: the export and import receipts for the original store conversion weren't found, so criterion 3's conversion rests on present absence, not on a receipt; the full gate and review pair for the original deletion are in the item's history, not re-read; no per-harness census by me (TermAl's w-3fe8f4472e5d criterion 6 owns that). Self-asserted under the baseline policy, no evaluation.
